text: PR #6661 review correctly found that generic + schema creation would emit malformed 0x30 tables without VFP Autoincrement metadata and that the test lacked raw storage evidence. The fix now leaves generic + creation/APPEND BLANK unsupported, exercises existing 0x31 tables with + descriptors plus persisted NextValue/step metadata, asserts generic creation still fails, and verifies imported ID bytes are exactly 01 00 00 00. Focused data-I/O and DBF tests pass.
